Define presentation and handling Identify the item, packed dimensions and whether the bag is for display, gifting or carrying. Confirm the opening, closure and any handle with a sample. A visual finish or carrying feature should be included in the approved drawing rather than assumed from the artwork. Check the bottom gusset Confirm the bottom gusset, filled footprint and stability at the intended fill level. Keep artwork clear of the base fold and seals. Review the filled sample against shelf depth before fixing the dieline. Review zipper access and final sealing Confirm zipper location, usable opening and the final top-seal allowance. Check filling access, opening and reclosing with the actual contents. Include any valve as a separate specified component. Resolve the material references The material and film entries describe different levels of detail or alternative options. Choose one final layer structure in the quotation; do not combine the lists into an assumed laminate. Confirm layer order, thicknesses, sealant and the testing needed for the intended contents. Confirm size and measurement basis The thickness reference is 130 µm (measurement basis to be confirmed). Confirm usable internal dimensions and test the intended fill quantity with the actual contents; weight, volume and flat dimensions are not interchangeable. Approve the artwork and print route Share artwork status, the number of designs and quantity per design.
